questions.question: Two days before the Passover, what did the chief priests and scribes look for a secret way to do to Jesus?

answers.text: Question Him in front of a crowd

questions.question: At Simon the Leper's home in Bethany, what did a woman do with her jar of expensive perfume?

answers.text: Broke it open and poured it on Jesus' head
Handed it to Simon as a gift for the house
Set it down unopened at Jesus' feet

questions.question: When a woman poured expensive perfume on Jesus in Bethany, what did He say her perfume did for His body?

answers.text: Anointed it in advance of His burial
Marked it as the body of the coming king
Made it ready for the Passover meal
